title: Actual finite-Q3 shifted force one-step bound
question: Does the actual onsite cubic plus Q3-lock edge force and spatial linear force admit an exact source-shift coefficient bound uniform in the finite volume?

model.Q_and_S: Q=max |q_(x,e)| and S=max |source_(x,e)| over the finite field

scoped_verdict: The exact shifted Q3 edge-force coefficient table is (12,12,4) by source degree 1,2,3. Summing the three Q3 neighbours and the six-neighbour spatial linear term gives the declared one-step bound; both exact lanes verify it for the finite side-2 field fixture. This is an actual Q3 one-step estimate, not a repeated-history, thermodynamic, or QFT theorem.
